notes_for_editor: Thin record: one tower list is the only source; no build, design, staffing, status or access source was found. Two Echols entries (this record, GA095, and us-ga-pineland-gfc, GA265) sit about 4.8 km apart by the listed coordinates (distance computed); GA265 lies at a bearing of about 163 degrees from this tower, i.e. south-south-east. The editor should check whether they are two towers or one. The list's elevation column has no unit; 141 is read as feet. The list's naming note says names for towers 73 and above are the author's own creation (this tower is GA095), so 'pineland' is not evidence of a historical name. The record's register reads 'GFC US 828', but the list tags it 'gfc-828' with no 'US'; check the format before changing it. Searches turned up the 2026 Pineland Road Fire in Echols and Clinch counties, but no source ties that fire to this tower, so it is not used. Searches ran through websearch.py (three queries covering Echols/Pineland; no tower-specific history found).
